_README: Lighter and Hyperliquid perpetuals whose index really is USDC, for scripts/check_perp_quotes.py.
Everything else on these platforms tracks USDT (crypto) or USD (stocks, ETFs, commodities,
FX, pre-IPO) while settling in USDC, so `quote: usd-coin` there fails the check.
Each key is '<platform>:<instrument id>'; the value is the evidence.
hyperliquid:HYPE: Hyperliquid's contract specifications price HYPE against its own HYPE/USDC spot book (docs/sdk-native-market-ids.md, "Hyperliquid quote exceptions").
hyperliquid:PURR: Hyperliquid's contract specifications price PURR against its own PURR/USDC spot book (docs/sdk-native-market-ids.md, "Hyperliquid quote exceptions").
